item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Feasibility and Accuracy Assessment of Applied Geophysical Methods for Ground Characterization - 2026_IDR_DICA_21 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-07 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Earth sciences / 04/GEOS-04 Geofisica

The research activity will focus on assessing the feasibility and accuracy of applied geophysical methods for ground and subsurface characterization. The project will involve field and laboratory experimental activities aimed at acquiring geophysical data through the use of suitable techniques and instruments for the reconstruction of the physical and geomechanical properties of soils. The work will include the planning of measurement campaigns, the execution of experimental surveys, quality control of the collected data, and the subsequent processing and interpretation of the results.
